statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to detect arrhythmic events and guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate-control management
The diagnosis codes are I49.5 and I48.0
The denial reason is CO-197, indicating that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
